description: This file defines the main entry point for a process that manages plugin spawning, including thread pool management, interface acquisition, environment setup, and process lifecycle handling.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Implements a worker pool with thread dispatching and callback handling for plugin processing.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Handles lifecycle events and signals for the worker pool, including shutdown signaling.

classes.name: ConsoleOptions
classes.description: Parses and manages command-line options for process configuration.

classes.name: ProcessFlow
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of the plugin process, including startup, run, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes environment, processes command-line arguments, and spawns plugin processes.

methods.name: Startup
methods.description: Initializes the process with thread count, remote node, and callsign.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Loads proxy stubs and starts the communication channel for plugin execution.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Signals the process to stop execution.
